name: isPicker
label: File Picker Mode
description: When true, the component is in picker mode.

name: isPickerOpened
label: Picker Opened
description: When true, the picker modal opens.

name: selectionDisabledItems
label: Selection Disabled Items
description: Array of row keys that need to be disabled for selection.

name: disableDMS
label: Hide ServiceNow DMS
description: When true, the ServiceNow DMS is hidden in the file picker.

name: forUpload
label: Upload Mode
description: When true, the file picker is to upload document to any folder. Other wise it is for download/linking.

name: showLinkOnlyCheckbox
label: Show Link Only Checkbox
description: When true, Link only checkbox is shown for external drive use cases.
